each finite ghost block is nondegenerate and its Berezin order is the declared convention
the interface integration and both endpoint kernels use the same x-polarization and +i0 branch

theorem_guards.hypotheses: T_1,T_2,m,hbar are positive and both slabs plus the interface Gaussian use the same +i0 continuation
theorem_guards.theorem: damped Fresnel Gaussian composition on one continued square-root branch
